Do you enjoy providing technical customer support and application expertise for human movement technology? Do you have experience in humanoid robotics, AI, and/or motion capture applications. We'd love to have you!

Who is Xsens

Xsens is a leading full-stack provider of sensors, software, and analytics that enable the digitization of movement. Xsens serves the entertainment, health & sports, humanoid robotics and automation & mobility markets. Our innovations enable our customers to capitalize on the value of movement by transforming data into meaningful and actionable insights. Partnering with leading global brands such as Electronic Arts, Netflix, Toyota, Siemens, NVIDIA, Scania and over 1000 sports organizations/research centers/universities, Xsens is creating extraordinary outcomes that move humanity forward. Xsens is a portfolio company of Francisco Partners, visit to learn more.

Your role as a Product Specialist at Xsens

As a Product Specialist, you provide technical pre-sales and post-sales support to customers across the Americas region including regular onsite visits. You work with customers in humanoid robotics, biomechanics research, sports science, rehabilitation, ergonomics, and other human movement applications.

You combine technical expertise with a customer-focused mindset, helping customers successfully implement Xsens solutions and maximize the value of motion capture technology. Humanoid robotics is an important growth market for Xsens, and you actively support emerging customer applications where human motion data is used for robotics, AI, robot learning, digital humans, and human-machine interaction.

Through your interactions with customers and partners, you contribute valuable market insights that help shape future products and services. Remote or based in Los Angelos, California, you will be part of Xsens’ global Customer Support team, collaborating closely with Account Executives, Product Management, R&D, and Customer Support Product Specialists worldwide.

Key responsibilities

  • Support emerging application areas such as humanoid robotics, robot learning, AI-driven motion analysis, digital humans, and human-machine interaction.

  • Provide technical support and application expertise to customers and partners, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Deliver product demonstrations, training, workshops, webinars, and technical presentations online, on-site, and at events or conferences.

  • Support customers applying Xsens motion capture technology in humanoid robotics, robot learning, AI-driven motion analysis, and related human movement applications.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and proactively enhance pre-sales and post-sales support processes.

  • Develop customer-facing materials, including knowledge articles, tutorials, application notes, training resources, and best-practice documentation.

  • Gather customer feedback, market insights, and application trends to support Product Management and R&D in future product development.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.

Requirements

Xsens is looking for a self-starting and responsible Product Specialist who thrives in an innovative, international, and customer-focused environment. You have:

  • MSc degree in Robotics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong understanding of biomechanics and human movement analysis.

  • 2-5 years’ experience with humanoid robotics, robotics research, AI, machine learning, or human-machine interaction.

  • Experience working in a remote or hybrid international team, with the ability to work independently, manage priorities proactively, communicate clearly across time zones, and stay closely aligned with colleagues, customers, and stakeholders.

  • Experience in technical support, application engineering, research, or customer-facing technical role is preferred.

  • Experience with motion capture systems, wearable sensors, IMU-based technology, or robotics applications is a strong advantage.

  • Experience with Python, C++, MATLAB, ROS, machine learning workflows, or data analysis tools is advantageous.

  • Excellent technical, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, up to 30% of your time.

What makes you successful

You are passionate about understanding human movement and how motion data can be applied to real-world challenges. You are excited by developments in biomechanics, motion capture, AI, and the rapidly growing field of humanoid robotics. Whether through academic projects, professional experience, research, or personal interest, you have a genuine curiosity for how technology can enable robots and AI systems to better understand and replicate human motion.

You combine strong technical knowledge with a proactive attitude and a genuine desire to help customers succeed.

Working at Xsens

We value ingenious ideas, no matter where they come from. We believe diverse thoughts, voices, and backgrounds make us stronger as a company. We know that it is through collaboration with people from all walks of life that we make the most positive impact as an organization.

Join Xsens’ innovative, ambitious, and international team, where your ideas and talents make an impact. Along with a competitive compensation package, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your well-being and help you thrive.

  • Comprehensive health coverage from day one, with 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents—including access to HSA-qualified options

  • Company-provided life insurance for added peace of mind

This position reports to the Executive Director, Data Management, Oncology and is part of the Data Management Oncology organization, which supports high-quality clinical trial execution through data oversight, risk identification, documentation, analytics, and cross-functional study support. The role is responsible for providing study-level leadership for Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) across Phase 1 to Phase 4 oncology clinical trials and works closely with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Project Teams, Quality, and other partner functions to ensure proactive risk assessment, centralized monitoring, mitigation planning, inspection readiness, and aligned execution of SMPA RBQM strategy.

  • Facilitate understanding and adoption of the SMPA RBQM strategy within Clinical Project Teams by providing targeted training, practical guidance, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Lead and facilitate cross-functional study risk assessment meetings, including planning, meeting facilitation, documentation of decisions, and follow-through on mitigation actions.
  • Own the development, maintenance, and periodic update of Risk Assessment Categorization Tools (RACTs), Quality Risk Management Plans (QRMPs), and related quality parameter documentation for assigned studies.
  • Ensure functional study plans align with approved risk assessments, Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors, protocol requirements, quality parameters, and data quality objectives.
  • Partner with Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and other functional stakeholders to define, implement, monitor, interpret, and escalate key risk indicators (KRIs), quality tolerance limits (QTLs), and centralized monitoring outputs.
  • Lead centralized monitoring activities, including ongoing data review, signal detection, trend analysis, documentation of findings, risk escalation, mitigation planning, and follow-through with accountable stakeholders.
  • Provide expert guidance on targeted source data verification (SDV) and targeted source data review (SDR) approaches based on evolving risk profiles and study-level quality signals.

jobs.description:
A Dito é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu em 2008 em meio à atmosfera de inovação do San Pedro Valley, em Belo Horizonte. O objetivo da nossa plataforma é otimizar o relacionamento entre as empresas e seus clientes, com soluções personalizadas, aproximando os consumidores de suas reais necessidades de maneira inteligente, segmentada por meio de diversos canais.

Desde 2017, somos honrados como uma Excelente Empresa para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, e esse reconhecimento é, sem dúvidas, devido ao que mais valorizamos por aqui: as PESSOAS!

Quer fazer parte dessa trajetória? Vem ser FERA! Mas afinal, o que é ser FERA?

Ser FERA significa:

  • Absorver e propagar a cultura e os valores da Dito: pega e Faz, com foco e planejamento; age com Ética e transparência; se preocupa com o Resultado do cliente; trabalha com Alegria e sede por Aprender.

  • Agir sob a orientação de metas e dados, sempre com foco na excelência dos resultados dos nossos clientes e no bem-estar das pessoas que tornam isso possível.

  • Interagir, colaborar, usar e aprender, independentemente dos cargos ou das áreas. No mercado, estreitamos desvios e conectamos pessoas. Dentro da empresa não poderia ser diferente. Na Dito, as pessoas torcem umas pelas outras.

  • Compreender, respeitar e admirar as diferenças, transformar as oportunidades de enxergar o mundo a partir de perspectivas diferentes daquelas que já conhecemos.

  • Trabalhar com leveza e equilíbrio, valorizando o próprio bem-estar e, claro, o das outras pessoas.

Por que estamos criando um banco de talentos para Pessoas Negras?

A Dito é uma empresa comprometida com a promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças e buscamos construir um ambiente de acolhimento, pluralidade e respeito às singularidades para que todas as pessoas se sintam livres para serem elas mesmas.

Sabemos que esse é apenas o início de nossa jornada, e estamos engajados no propósito de aumentar a representatividade de pessoas negras no time de FERAs. Por isso, este banco é exclusivo para pessoas pertencentes a essa comunidade.

Valorizamos pessoas que tenham o pega e Faz com Foco e planejamento na veia, que prezem pela Ética e transparência, tenham foco nos Resultados dos clientes, trabalhem com Alegria e sede por Aprender. Então, se você se encaixa e acredita que estes valores fazem a diferença, nós estamos buscando justamente por você!

Quem pode se inscrever?

Sabemos que ainda estamos muito distantes de ter uma sociedade igualitária e com oportunidades iguais para todos e que pessoas negras enfrentam uma forte desigualdade no mercado de trabalho e por esta razão criamos este espaço.

Por isso, se você se identifica como uma pessoa negra, candidate-se e #VemSerFERA!

Nossos benefícios:

  • Dito Flex - VR e VA flexíveis pagos no cartão Caju (você escolhe como usar seu saldo de acordo com suas necessidades e preferência);
  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil com abrangência nacional, sem coparticipação e com inclusão de dependentes (filhos e cônjuges);

  • Auxílio escritório, para ajudar a custear parte dos gastos gerados pelo trabalho remoto;

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) com planos variados, inclusive um grátis;
  • Parceria com o Sesc, com descontos em serviços de educação, saúde, cultura, esporte, turismo, lazer e assistência;
  • Licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, válidas também para casos de adoção e guarda judicial. Durante esse período, a pessoa continua recebendo o VA/VR.

Outras vantagens que tornam a Dito um lugar especial ❤️:

  • Carga horária de 40 horas semanais com horários flexíveis de verdade;
  • Total liberdade de estilo, nada de dress code por aqui;
  • Diversos incentivos ao aprendizado (em participação em cursos, eventos, talks e meetups, compra de livros, biblioteca interna, entre outros);
  • Lanches, games e fliperama à vontade no escritório para relaxar durante os intervalos;
  • Convênios e descontos em vários restaurantes, academias, instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, entre outros;
  • Confraternizações constantes e eventos de integração entre equipes para proporcionar novas associações e amizades;
  • Falando em equipes, nossos times de futebol (feminino e masculino), batem um bolão;
  • Para quem não vive sem música, temos uma banda de FERAs!
  • Comitês internos de diversidade que realizam eventos direcionados, debates, aprendizados e iniciativas de conscientização e inclusão de grupos minorizados.

A Dito é uma empresa que respeita e apoia a diversidade e a inclusão. Portanto, não fazemos diferenciação de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças.

Se você gostou do que leu, encontrou uma oportunidade com o seu perfil e quer fazer parte de uma Excelente Empresas para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, inscreva-se agora mesmo para ter uma chance de se juntar a nós! Caso você dê match com alguma das nossas oportunidades, entraremos em contato =).

Boa sorte!

jobs.description:
Department Overview

The Utilization Management Department enacts the hospital UR Plan. The department provides for the assessment of the medical necessity of admission and continued stay, appropriate bed status, denials management, and outlier review. The department provides clinical information to third party payers to assure medical necessity requirements are met to secure authorization.

Function/Duties of Position

Utilization Nurse Role:

Utilization Management Nurses work within the multidisciplinary team to determine medical necessity of admission and continued stay in the hospital as well as correct patient classification and efficient use of resources. They conduct robust utilization review. Utilization Management Nurses use established criteria to determine appropriateness of admission and continued stay and work with payers to assure ongoing authorization for continued stay. They contribute to meeting OHSU’s strategic plan of safe LOS reduction and reduction in readmission rates.

Patient populations served:• Utilization Management functions are also contracted out to our collaborative site at Columbia Memorial (CMH), Adventist Health (AHPL), and Hillsboro Medical Center (HMC).• Utilization Management completes admission and concurrent reviews on all hospitalized patients regardless of payer, age, or location of admission. They are available to assist in utilization management questions for patients in outpatient spaces and will complete pre-reviews for specific surgical types/locations as consulted.

Skill mix: identify minimum qualifications and competencies necessary to work within department:• The UM functions have been delegated from the Clinical Resource Management Committee (CRMC) by the facilities’ professional board and the activities of the department are reported up through the Regulatory Oversight Committee (ROC). • The Utilization Management department is comprised of primarily registered nurses who hold previous Utilization Management experiences that qualify them for the role. • A physician advisor of UM will also assist with reviewing the utilization of clinical care as well as level of care. The UM physician advisor is used in processes as outlined by the UR plan and acts as the chair of the CRMC committee. • Administrative staff also assist in the performance and evaluation of the Utilization Management activities by designing and implementing systems to enhance data collection and facilitate record review.

Core staffing and methods for determining and modifying staffing to meet patient or process needs:• Assignments are established daily by the UM charge RN to ensure coverage of OHSU hospital units as well as contractual collaborative sites such as AHPL, CMH, and HMC.

Description of assessment and reassessment practices, including timeframes:• Admissions are reviewed within one business day by an UM RN who will screen on the necessity of the admission based on the designated screening criteria. • Concurrent reviews are completed by the UM RN every three days or sooner, when consulted, to evaluate the continue medical need for the patient in a hospitalized level of care. They will collaborate with the care management team and/or UM physician advisor when it is determined that the patient is no longer meeting an acute hospital level of care. • If admission or continued stay is deemed to not be medically necessary, the UM RN will work collaboratively with the UM physician advisor and attending provider for review and determination if non-covered service notice is appropriate to be given to the patient. • In accordance with the CMS regulations, outlier reviews are completed at OHSU. A representative of the UM department is present at the outlier reviews to assist in UM needs or additional medical necessity reviews for the team. • Utilization Management RNs also work collaboratively with the PBS and revenue cycle teams to review clinical data for medical necessity denials. They assist in writing appeal letters as well as identification of trends with payers to elevate specifically to those payers or to make change within the UM processes for denial prevention in the future. • The UM team works collaboratively with the physician community on issues related to UM to assist in problem solving, acting as a resource, or to assisting educational efforts. • The UM department functions within the regulations of DNV and CMS as well as the UR plan that has been approved by the hospitals governing body.

  • Proficiency in use of Microsoft Officeo Word: create documents or outlines that may include use of tables, bullets, headers, footers, and basic formattingo Excel: ability to create and use basic spreadsheets that do not involve formulas or pivot tables.o Powerpoint: ability to create basic presentations in outline form using approved OHSU graphics• Proficient at creating formal presentations and presenting to groups of medical professionals• Demonstrated proficiency with conflict resolution• Demonstrated proficiency working cooperatively and productively to achieve shared goals as a member of a team. • Excellent written communication skills, including demonstrated ability to compose persuasive and grammatically correct written arguments• Excellent verbal communication skills• Successful experience in a leadership role in the past 10 years (eg: charge nurse, nurse manager, UBNPC chair, group facilitator, hospital-wide committee membership, etc.)• Proficiency within the interdisciplinary team in resolving conflicts, communicating and educating physicians on patient status decisions and other issues related to Utilization Management.• Proficient in use of Interqual or MCG criteria.• Understanding of the CMS rules and regulations.• Ability and willingness to do presentations to groups of physicians and hospital leadership.• Demonstrated ability to work independently with a minimum of supervision while meeting performance targets.

Department Specific Working Conditions: Utilization Management follows patients on every inpatient, observation, and overnight day stay unit and the Emergency department. Some work occurs in support of procedural areas as well.Each Utilization Management Nurse has access to a computer work station as this is a teleworking position. There is heavy frequent use of computers and telephones.

jobs.description:
Seattle & Washington State Organizing Director Job Description

Full-Time | Remote

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

About UNDIVIDED

UNDIVIDED is committed to building meaningful impact through community-centered work, relationship-driven engagement, cultivating spaces of belonging, and moving people into redemptive action for healing and justice in their communities.

Position Summary

UNDIVIDED is seeking a strategic, relational, and community rooted Organizing Director for Seattle and Washington State to lead and grow our community organizing and impact in the Pacific Northwest. This role will oversee building a strong base of strong leaders, teams, clergy, and institutions who are aligned with Kingdom values, advancing healing, and pursuing Biblical justice in their neighborhoods and regions.

This role will play a critical leadership role in building and growing the organizing and justice culture of UNDIVIDED through deep listening, leadership development, ongoing training, and strategic campaigns that advance justice in Seattle and Washington State, while providing key learnings and growth for organizing nationally through UNDIVIDED. The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, comfortable with managing campaigns and collaborating across teams in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Recruit and develop leaders and teams deeply rooted in their church and community

  • Regularly Engage church leaders (staff and congregational members) through 1:1 conversations
  • Engage in regular listening, both formal and informal, to insure the voices, passion, and leadership of local people are driving the organizing
  • Develop, train, and support leader led teams in congregations and institutions
  • Identify and develop organizing champions who are leading, building a following, and wielding redemptive power in the public arena
  • Lead and support regular trainings both collectively and inside institutions on the fundamentals of organizing

2. Guide and support strategic justice campaigns

  • Work with leaders, clergy and congregations to determine what challenges and problems are in the way of justice for the people
  • Work with leaders to explore possible justice campaigns with issue cuts and a path to winning
  • Launch and execute justice campaigns in ways that develop leaders, grow the redemptive power of the organization, and advance the identified justice campaign
  • At conclusion of campaign, reflect, celebrate, and explore next campaign opportunities

3. Support growing Organizing Movement through UNDIVIDED

  • Serve as part of UNDIVIDED’s organizing team
  • Work with team members and other local network leads to grow as a leader and organizer
  • Reflect on and develop strategies to overcome internal and external barriers to stronger individual and collective leadership
  • Experiment with strategies, tactics, and procedures to refine best practices that can be applied in Seattle and beyond

Required Qualifications

  • Deep commitment to grassroots organizing, leadership development, justice work, and the mission of UNDIVIDED.
  • 2+ years of experience in community organizing, movement-building, campaign strategy, leadership development, or related work.
  • Demonstrated success developing leaders, coaching organizers, or supporting distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of grassroots organizing, relational organizing, power-building, and campaign strategy.
  • Experience facilitating training, leadership development spaces, or group learning environments.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build trust and work effectively across diverse communities and leadership styles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support complex projects simultaneously.
  • Experience navigating fast-paced, evolving, and high-pressure environments with steadiness and strategic thinking.
  • Strong organizational skills and systems thinking.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 15% of the time.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including occasional evenings and weekends as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing or coordinating distributed organizing networks or grassroots teams.
  • Experience in faith-based organizing or faith-rooted justice work.
  • Experience facilitating political education or leadership formation spaces.
  • Bilingual or multilingual skills are strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in coalition environments and cross-organizational partnerships.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: Depending on experience.

Retirement plan and employer 401(k) contribution.

Health, dental, and vision insurance.

Paid time off and holidays.

Professional development opportunities.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

This position operates in a remote work environment. Employees regularly use standard equipment such as computers, phones, and video conferencing tools to collaborate with teams and leadership. Attendance at two annual staff retreats is required, along with occasional in-person participation at meetings or events. Some evening or weekend availability may be needed.

How to Apply

To apply, please visit our careers page on our website and submit your resume and a brief cover letter. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Equal Employment Opportunity

UNDIVIDED is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren.
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als wegweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Umfeld eingesetzt.

Wir bauen derzeit ein neues Team auf, das für den Produktbereich Shopware Pulse verantwortlich sein wird. Dieser umfasst alle Themen rund um das Management von Abonnements, Zahlungen und Übernutzungen (Overages) unserer Shopware Services.

Als Backend Engineer verantwortest du zentrale Service-zu-Service-Infrastrukturen, Datenpipelines und APIs, die sowohl interne Abläufe als auch merchant-seitige Funktionen antreiben. Die Rolle richtet sich an Engineers mit Begeisterung für skalierbare, verteilte Systeme, API-getriebene Architekturen und Cloud-native Lösungen, die ihr Skillset perspektivisch in Richtung Full-Stack-Entwicklung erweitern möchten.

Egal von wo aus du arbeitest, du bist ein fester Bestandteil des Teams. Daher suchen wir deutschlandweit/europaweit nach einem Backend Engineer (m/w/d) für unser Service Enablement Team!

Requirements

  • Entwurf, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Go-basierten gRPC-Services, einschließlich OAuth-Flows, Integrationen und Caching-Strategien

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Service-Backends in TypeScript/ (z. B. mit Hono), einschließlich interner und Merchant-APIs, Background-Workern und geplanten Jobs

  • Gestaltung von Contract-First-APIs (Protobuf/OpenAPI), inklusive Versionierungsstrategien und sicherer Rollouts über mehrere konsumierende Services hinweg

  • Verantwortung für Datenzuverlässigkeit und -konsistenz über Redis-Caches, MySQL-Persistenz und asynchrone Job-Queues (z. B. SQS)

  • Implementierung von Sicherheits- und Multi-Tenant-Zugriffsmustern, darunter M2M-Authentifizierung, signierte Query-Parameter und interne Authentifizierungsmechanismen

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Observability und Resilienz, einschließlich strukturierter Logs, Metriken, Tracing, Retry-Mechanismen und Backpressure-Strategien

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Platform- und Infrastruktur-Teams zur Optimierung AWS-basierter Deployments (ECS, Terraform, CI/CD, Secret-Management)

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Go und/oder TypeScript (Node.js)

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Einsatz KI-gestützter Coding-Tools wie Cursor, Claude Code und Antigravity, inklusive klar definierter Prozesse zur Sicherstellung hochwertiger Code-Generierung

  • Starker Hintergrund in verteilten Systemen, APIs (gRPC/REST) und Service-zu-Service-Integrationen

  • Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken (MySQL) sowie Caching-Systemen (Redis) im produktiven Einsatz und bei hoher Last

  • Vertrautheit mit asynchroner Verarbeitung und Job-Queues (SQS oder vergleichbare Systeme)

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (AWS), containerisierten Deployments (Docker, ECS) und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform

  • Klare Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, ausgeprägtes Ownership-Mindset und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

Learning & Development Growth Enablement Lead

The Learning & Development Growth Enablement Lead is responsible for translating business growth priorities - particularly in business development (BD), consulting, and critical in-the-moment learning needs - into targeted, skill-driven learning and enablement solutions.

This role bridges business needs, skills intelligence, and learning execution to ensure employees are equipped with the skills required to win work, deliver client value, and perform effectively in real time. The Lead will define skill standards, design and deliver learning experiences, and integrate across the learning and skills ecosystem to create a cohesive, measurable, and scalable growth enablement strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Business Alignment

  • Partner with the Director, Learning Strategy and business SMEs to understand growth priorities in business development, consulting, and client delivery.
  • Translate growth enablement and critical “in-the-moment” skill needs and learning requests into actionable solutions (programs, skill labs, tools, and on-the-job enablement).
  • Collaborate with the Director, Learning Strategy to ensure growth enablement learning investments are directly aligned to business strategy and outcomes.

Learning & Skill Strategy

  • Define critical growth enablement skills and “what good looks like” to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Set future-state growth enablement skill levels and establish clear guidelines, standards, and expectations for skill development across roles and levels.
  • Ensure the growth enablement skill development is aligned to workforce readiness priorities and the ICF people strategy.

Skills Intelligence & Governance

  • Define and maintain an evolving enterprise skills framework including governance, taxonomy, proficiency levels, and role-based skill mappings.
  • Partner across People Skills, Workday Skills, Viva Learning, and agents (workforce insights, learning) to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  • Identify growth enablement skill gaps and collaborate with the Director, Learning Strategy to use data to prioritize learning & development efforts and investments.

Learning Design & Development

  • Own the end-to-end design and development of growth enablement learning experiences, including:
    • Consulting skills
    • Business development skills
    • Critical in-the-moment skills
    • New or emerging growth enablement skills
  • Ensure learning is practical, applied, in-the-flow of work, and directly tied to day-to-day business scenarios.
  • Leverage modern learning approaches, including AI-enabled learning, personalized pathways, and adaptive learning.
  • Incorporate AI-enabled tools and guided prompt practice into learning experiences to drive hands-on application and accelerate on-the-job performance.

Delivery & Facilitation

  • Facilitate high-impact growth enablement learning experiences (virtual and in-person), including workshops, skill labs, and cohort-based programs.
  • Enable leaders and managers to reinforce growth enablement learning and support on-the-job application through communities of practice, coaching circles, mentoring, etc.
  • Build co-facilitator capabilities to support scalable delivery of growth enablement learning experiences.

Measurement & Impact

  • Partner with the learning team to define success measures across growth enablement programs, skill labs, and digital learning.
  • Track and report on growth enablement learning effectiveness, including:
    • Engagement and completion
    • Skill acquisition and proficiency shifts
    • Application on-the-job
    • Business impact (e.g., BD performance, client outcomes)
  • Use data and insights to continuously improve growth enablement learning solutions.

Integration Across HR

  • Connect growth enablement efforts across broader workforce readiness initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with other learning programs, enterprise skills framework, and priority HR initiatives (e.g. AI fluency).
  • Act as a connector across teams (leadership, employee experience, HR consulting, HR operations, talent acquisition, total rewards) to create a seamless experience.

Learning Ecosystem & Architecture

  • Lead the integration of growth enablement within the broader learning and skills ecosystem.
  • Ensure strong connections across systems and tools (e.g., learning platforms, skills systems, AI learning agents).
  • Design growth enablement learning experiences that are skill-driven, discoverable, and embedded in the flow of work.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in one of the following areas; Learning & Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Development, Education, Adult Learning / Adult Education, Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology, Workforce Development, Business Administration, Management Consulting, Organizational Leadership or Sales Management
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in learning & development, talent development, sales/business development enablement, organizational effectiveness, or professional services consulting.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing and delivering sales, business development, capture, proposal, consulting, or client-facing capability programs.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of professional services business development, seller-doer models, account growth, capture, proposal development, and client relationship management.
  • Experience partnering with business development leaders, account leaders, and subject matter experts to build capability aligned to growth priorities.
  • Proven ability to translate revenue, pipeline, and growth objectives into targeted learning and performance solutions.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, skill labs, boot camps, coaching programs, and leadership sessions for business and client-facing professionals.
  • Experience designing experiential learning, simulations, practice opportunities, and on-the-job reinforcement strategies.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise learning, skills, or capability-building initiatives.
  • Experience managing complex programs, stakeholder collaboration, SME engagement. and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Ability to operate strategically while also owning hands-on design and delivery
  • Experience with modern learning platforms (e.g., Viva Learning) and AI-enabled learning tools

The AI/ML Delivery Engineer is a hands-on senior practitioner who designs, builds, and scales enterprise AI, ML, and data products across cloud environments. This role combines deep engineering expertise with solution architecture, delivery leadership, and executive-level communication. This role supports the NIH mission by delivering secure, scalable, and innovative AI and data solutions that accelerate biomedical research, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making to advance human health.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

The ideal candidate can move from strategy to production implementation across intelligent search, generative AI chat, agentic workflows, predictive ML, computer vision, and medical AI imaging. They bridge data science, software engineering, platform engineering, and security to deliver robust, governed, cost-aware, fit-for-mission AI solutions.

Solution Design and Delivery

  • Architect and deliver end-to-end AI/ML and generative AI solutions across the full lifecycle, including data integration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Design scalable, secure, and governed AI/ML architectures that support enterprise data management, cloud-native services, distributed computing, and high-performance workloads.

  • Integrate enterprise AI and cloud services with organizational data platforms, security controls, governance frameworks, and operational processes.
  • Deliver AI and machine learning solutions across a variety of domains, including natural language processing, computer vision, predictive analytics, intelligent search, multimodal AI, and other mission-focused applications, using industry-standard frameworks and tools.
  • Design secure application programming interfaces (APIs), integration services, data pipelines, and orchestration workflows that enable AI capabilities to be reliably consumed by enterprise systems and end users.

Technical Leadership, Governance, and Delivery Excellence

  • Serve as the AI/ML technical authority for cross-functional data science, engineering, platform, security, infrastructure, and business teams.
  • Lead architecture reviews, AI readiness assessments, performance benchmarking, and infrastructure trade-off analysis for large-scale cloud, GPU, and distributed data workloads.
  • Establish MLOps, LLMOps, and ModelOps practices for CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, prompt/model versioning, automated testing, deployment promotion, rollback, drift/quality monitoring, lineage, and cost optimization.
  • Define responsible AI controls for privacy, IAM, key management, audit logging, PHI/PII handling, explain ability, model cards, bias/risk assessment, human oversight, and agentic guardrails.

  • Education: Master of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics/Statistics, Bioinformatics, Data Science, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Hands-on experience with modern enterprise data platforms and cloud-native data architectures, including distributed data processing, data governance, machine learning lifecycle management, and batch and streaming data pipelines.
  • Production experience developing, deploying, and supporting AI/ML and generative AI solutions, including intelligent search, large language model (LLM) applications, workflow automation, model serving, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with modern machine learning and deep learning frameworks, libraries, and tools for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML solutions.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and managing AI/ML solutions in one or more major cloud environments, including cloud-native AI services, identity and access management, networking, security, and infrastructure.
  • Experience working with large, complex, sensitive, or regulated datasets, including data integration, migration, quality management, analytics, visualization, and governance in government, healthcare, or other regulated environments.

Stord is revolutionizing the logistics industry with our cloud-based supply chain platform. Our AI team is building next-generation features like Demand Planning, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation that leverage both traditional ML models and cutting-edge LLM capabilities. We need an experienced Elixir engineer (ideally, a true polyglot that looks at languages as tools) who can seamlessly integrate these AI capabilities into our core platform.

You'll work directly with our Dir of AI Products to architect and build AI-powered features, collaborate with Data Scientists to understand model requirements, and partner with ML Engineers to create seamless integration between our ML infrastructure and core services. This is a hands-on role where you'll build the backbone services that make AI features accessible across our entire platform.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in making AI a first-class citizen in our broader platform. You'll work on critical features like demand forecasting APIs, intelligent routing services, and real-time prediction engines, with the opportunity to shape how AI integrates with our core logistics platform (and what tools we use internally!). This is a unique opportunity to have a massive impact on a team that's transforming supply chain operations through AI.

AI Platform Integration:

  • Build robust Elixir services that consume ML predictions from Modal.com, Vertex AI, and other ML platforms

  • Create fault-tolerant systems that gracefully handle service failures and provide intelligent fallbacks

  • Implement caching and optimization strategies for AI feature serving

  • Build real-time data pipelines using Kafka and Elixir processes to feed ML models

Production AI Features:

  • Develop Demand Planning services that integrate forecasting models with inventory management

  • Build intelligent routing systems that leverage ML predictions for optimal logistics decisions

  • Create real-time anomaly detection services for supply chain monitoring

  • Implement AI-powered recommendation engines for logistics optimization

Platform Architecture & Scalability:

  • Implement proper monitoring, alerting, and observability

  • Build developer tools and abstractions that make AI capabilities easy for other engineers to integrate

  • Create configuration management and feature flagging for experiments

  • Optimize performance and costs across the platform

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with the Dir of AI Products on architecture decisions and technical strategy

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists to understand model inputs, outputs, and constraints

  • Work with the ML/Data Engineers to ensure seamless model deployment integration

  • Support product teams in implementing AI features within their domains

  • TypeScript (2+ years) - You can switch between the best tool for the given task

  • Distributed Systems - Strong understanding of fault tolerance, supervision trees, and OTP patterns

jobs.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Solutions Sales Executive, Home Factors — Agency, Reinsurance & Platform Partnerships

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Solutions Sales Executive, Home Factors.

Home Factors is Porch Group Media's proprietary property condition scoring and risk analytics platform. It delivers a fundamentally differentiated view of individual property risk by combining proprietary home-attribute data, real-time property condition signals, and advanced scoring models that go well beyond traditional peril or claims-history data. The product is reshaping how reinsurers assess portfolio risk selection and treaty pricing adequacy, how MGAs build defensible underwriting programs for their capacity partners, and how insurance platforms and data marketplaces embed differentiated risk data into the products they distribute, and we need someone who can sell that transformation, not just a data feed.

This is a senior hunter role with deep consultative requirements, spanning two related but distinct motions: direct sales into agencies, reinsurers, and MGAs, and channel/partnership development with insurance platforms and data marketplaces that would embed or redistribute Home Factors. You will own the full lifecycle of complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, from initial prospecting through technical evaluation, partnership structuring, and executive-level commercial negotiation. Sales and partnership cycles are typically 6+ months and involve agency principals and brokerage leadership, reinsurance underwriting and portfolio management leadership, MGA underwriting and program leadership, platform business development and product teams, data science, integration engineering, and C-suite decision-makers. Home Factors is a new category of data in the market, and you will help define how agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, and platforms evaluate and buy or embed property condition data, educate senior stakeholders who may not yet know the category exists, and architect deal structures that align with how insurance data is actually consumed and monetized.

What You Will Do As A Solutions Sales Executive:

  • Pipeline & Partnership Development

  • Build and manage a full-cycle pipeline spanning retail and wholesale insurance agencies, reinsurers, program administrators and MGAs, and insurance platforms and data marketplaces, from strategic prospecting and cold outreach through multi-quarter evaluation cycles to signed subscription or partnership agreements.

  • Own an aggressive new-logo and new-partnership quota across direct and partnership channels, maintaining 3-4x pipeline coverage and delivering accurate, stage-weighted forecasts across long, complex cycles ranging from mid-five-figure licensing agreements to seven-figure annual subscriptions and revenue-share deals.

  • Independently maintain a territory and partnership plan that segments target accounts by agency size and specialty, reinsurer tier, MGA vertical and growth stage, and platform type, developing account-level strategies that map the buying or partnership committee and sequence engagement across stakeholders.

  • Maintain CRM data with stage-appropriate detail, including buying-committee or partnership-committee mapping and integration timelines, and report honestly and precisely on deal and partnership health, risk factors, and close timing.

  • Solution Design & Deal Execution

  • Partner with analytics, data science, and product teams to architect use cases specific to each channel, including property risk advisory and submission differentiation for agencies, reinsurance portfolio risk selection and treaty pricing support for reinsurers, underwriting segmentation and program risk selection for MGAs, and embedded scoring or data-licensing integrations for platforms.

  • Translate raw analytical output into a business case that resonates with agency, actuarial, underwriting, product, and executive stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Lead engagements that require coordinating across distinct buyer personas depending on account type, including agency principals and producers, reinsurer underwriting and cat-modeling leaders, MGA program managers and capacity providers, and platform business development, product, and integration engineering leaders, managing competing priorities and evaluation criteria to drive consensus and close.

  • Design and deliver executive-level pitch materials, technical deep-dive presentations, ROI models, and pricing or partnership proposals, and lead commercial negotiations involving custom data delivery formats, API integration terms, embedded distribution and revenue-share agreements, multi-year ramp structures, exclusivity provisions, and co-development commitments.

  • Market Presence & Thought Leadership

  • Represent Home Factors at agency, reinsurance, MGA, and insurtech industry conferences and partnership forums, presenting to agency, underwriting, actuarial, product, and C-suite leadership as a credible, technically informed voice on property risk data innovation and embedded data partnerships.

What You Will Bring As A Solutions Sales Executive:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in complex, consultative B2B sales, including at least 4 years selling data, analytics, or decision-science solutions directly into insurance agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, or insurance/insurtech platforms.

  • Strong preference for experience selling into agency or brokerage leadership, reinsurance underwriting or portfolio management, MGA underwriting or program management, or structuring embedded data/technology partnerships.

  • Comfortable holding a substantive conversation with a reinsurance Chief Underwriting Officer, an MGA program leader, an agency principal, or a platform's Head of Product about loss ratios, combined ratios, portfolio risk selection, treaty pricing, submission quality, and GLM/GBM modeling approaches, with enough analytical fluency to co-design a proof of concept and defend the methodology to a skeptical buyer or partner.

  • An active network of senior relationships across insurance agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, and insurance platform or data-partnership leaders, with the ability to get a meeting with a decision-maker rather than a gatekeeper.

  • A demonstrable track record of exceeding quota in enterprise sales or partnership environments with 6+ month cycles, multiple decision-makers, technical evaluations, and six- to seven-figure contract or partnership values, including experience navigating procurement, legal, and integration/security reviews.

  • Self-directed and resourceful, comfortable operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where the go-to-market and partnership motion is still being built.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to flex between a technical data validation conversation with an actuarial or product team and a strategic business case for a C-suite sponsor or partnership executive with equal ease.

jobs.description:
Who You Are:

The Safety Manager is responsible for proactively and strategically developing, coordinating, and directing company-wide safety compliance programs, systems, and initiatives, to include safety training, incident investigation/follow-up, incident prevention programs, safety awareness programs, and minimizing risk exposure(s). The position is pertaining to recurring maintenance and minor repair of fuel facilities for the Department of Defense (DoD).

*This position is contingent upon award.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the Safety Management System (SMS) for RMMR. Specifically, implement comprehensive safety programs and policies in accordance with applicable safety regulations, USACE EM 385-1-1 guidelines, and industry best practices. This includes creating safety plans, procedures, and protocols specific to maintenance and repair projects within the USACE RMMR program. Ensure that the SMS integrates with other corporate functions.
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local safety regulations, as well as USACE EM 385-1-1 and service-specific safety standards. Stay updated with regulatory changes and communicate updates to project teams and contractors. Conduct regular inspections and audits to identify potential safety hazards and non-compliance issues. Ensure identified deficiencies and areas for improvement are tracked and trended. Work with project teams and contractors to implement corrective actions. Monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures.
  • Identify potential safety hazards and assess risks associated with construction activities. Conduct accident hazard analyses (AHAs) and safety assessments to proactively address potential risks. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate hazards and reduce risks to an acceptable level.
  • Develop and deliver safety training programs to project teams, contractors, and other personnel. Ensure that all workers receive appropriate safety training, including new-hire orientations and specific training for high-risk activities. Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns and educational initiatives.
  • Lead and conduct thorough investigations of safety incidents, accidents, and near-miss events. Identify root causes and contributing factors and recommend corrective actions to prevent future incidents. Prepare and submit incident reports to regulatory agencies as required.
  • Perform regular safety audits and inspections to assess compliance with safety policies, procedures, and regulations. Identify deficiencies and areas for improvement, and work with project teams and contractors to implement corrective actions. Monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures.
  • Develop and implement emergency response plans and procedures. Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and local emergency services to ensure preparedness for potential emergencies. Conduct drills and exercises to test the effectiveness of emergency response plans.
  • Promote open lines of communication regarding safety matters among project teams, contractors, and regulatory agencies. Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve safety-related issues and foster a proactive safety culture. Participate in safety meetings, committees, and industry organizations to stay informed about safety trends and best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local safety regulations, including Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards. Familiarity with USACE EM 385-1-1 safety regulations, policies, and guidelines is mandatory. Be comfortable with briefing senior officials and conduct summary status briefings no less than quarterly.

Supervisory:

  • This position may have supervisory responsibilities. If supervisory responsibilities exist, and the individual must mentor subordinate staff.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Must have a bachelor's degree in occupational health and safety, engineering, or a related field. Relevant work experience in safety management, preferably in the construction, repair, or maintenance industry, is preferred with a minimum of 5 years safety experience.
  • Have experience and familiarity with Safety Management Systems.
  • Documented proficiency in developing and implementing safety programs, policies, and procedures.
  • Experience in hazard identification, risk mitigation practices, and incident investigations. Knowledge of safety training techniques and the ability to develop and deliver effective safety training programs.
  • Must be able to read, write and speak English fluently. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, contracts, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.
  • Successful results of pre-employment screenings, including federal background check, MVR, and drug screen.

About the Team/Role

Our Global Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of attracting, sourcing, and hiring the exceptional talent that drives our business forward. We provide a best-in-class experience for candidates and hiring teams, balancing high performance with a collaborative culture.

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive end-to-end recruitment strategies for our complex Sales, Marketing, and Operations requisitions. In this senior role, you will serve as a strategic talent partner to senior leadership, leveraging ATS and CRM technologies to build high-performing talent pipelines, mentor junior team members, and optimize recruiting workflows. This is a high-impact position ideal for a seasoned recruiter who thrives on data-driven sourcing, talent advisory, and continuous process improvement in a fast-paced global organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Lead full life-cycle recruiting for complex, high-priority sales and corporate business functions, serving as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership and hiring managers.

  • Conduct comprehensive intake meetings to define role requirements, establish SLA timelines, coach hiring teams on advanced interview techniques, and set competitive market expectations.

  • Architect creative, multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Phenom CRM, and proactive outreach to build robust, diverse pipelines for critical enterprise roles.

  • Conduct rigorous candidate evaluations focused on core competencies, leadership potential, and culture alignment; craft competitive compensation offers, navigate complex counter-offers, and close top-tier candidates.

  • Identify and resolve recruitment funnel bottlenecks, recommend process optimizations, and leverage automation to improve metrics like time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and candidate conversion rates.

  • Deliver a high-touch, transparent experience for all candidates while advocating for employer brand consistency across every touchpoint.

  • Ensure precise tracking across Workday ATS and Phenom CRM, maintaining strict compliance with EEO, ADA, affirmative action guidelines, and global hiring regulations.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert within the GTA team, sharing best practices and supporting the onboarding and development of junior talent acquisition team members.

Experience You’ll Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full life-cycle recruiting experience in a corporate or high-growth environment, with a proven track record handling senior-level enterprise roles.

  • Advanced expertise sourcing and closing roles within Sales (Enterprise Account Executives, Leadership, SDRs) and Business Operations (Marketing, HR, Finance).

  • Hands-on proficiency with Workday ATS and candidate relationship management tools like Phenom CRM.

  • Advanced skills using LinkedIn Recruiter, boolean search methods, and modern sourcing tech stacks.

  • AI & Tech Aptitude: Proven track record of leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, AppScripts) to streamline recruitment workflows, synthesize talent market data, and enhance candidate engagement strategies with strong critical evaluation skills.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Influence: Ability to build strong relationships, push back constructively, and influence VP-level stakeholders.

  • Advanced Negotiation: Mastered negotiation techniques capable of closing passive, highly sought-after candidates in competitive markets.

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Ability to translate recruitment metrics into actionable insights to optimize hiring funnel velocity and quality.

  • Agility & Resilience: High capability to manage competing priorities, complex requisitions, and dynamic business pivots smoothly.

GTA Guiding Principles & Behaviors

  • Be Authentically Transparent: Build trust through open, honest communication with candidates and managers.

  • Seek and Hire the Best Talent:Maintain bar-raising standards for every team we touch.

  • Innovate and Simplify: Find smarter, streamlined ways to work and reduce recruiter/candidate friction.

  • Take Ownership: Own the outcome from initial kickoff to successful candidate onboarding.

  • Learn and Be Curious:Continuously learn new sourcing strategies, business functions, and market trends.

jobs.description:
Join the core team at Eclipse, where we’re building an AI agent-first marketplace that connects intelligence with real-world tasks, starting with data collection and labeling. We are seeking a Data Scientist to establish the foundation for how our data is labeled, processed, and prepared for consumption by next-generation Large Language Models (LLMs). Your work will be critical in transforming our raw data collections into valuable, AI-ready datasets.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on data quality and preparation.
  • Strong understanding of data labeling methodologies and hands-on experience with data annotation platforms and workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing datasets for training and fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), including knowledge of techniques like tokenization, embeddings, and NER.
  • Proficiency in Python and common data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, spaCy, Hugging Face).
  • Experience using APIs/SDKs to automate data annotation and active learning loops.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an ability to create clear documentation for technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop Data Labeling Strategies: Design and document a formal data annotation strategy, including clear, scalable, and efficient guidelines for labeling our data. Define and enforce quality metrics, including inter-annotator agreement.
  • Optimize for LLM Consumption: Research, define, and prototype the optimal data formats, structures, and pre-processing steps required for fine-tuning and training LLMs on our datasets.
  • Data Quality Analysis: Establish automated processes and metrics to analyze the quality of both raw and labeled data, providing feedback to improve our data collection and labeling workflows.
  • Collaborate with Engineering: Work closely with the engineering team to guide the implementation of data processing pipelines and ensure the data infrastructure meets the needs of ML applications.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with audio data processing and relevant libraries.
  • Familiarity with data annotation platforms and tools.
  • Knowledge of modern MLOps principles and practices.
  • Experience with large language model data curation and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines.

Join the Eclipse team!

Eclipse is building the fastest Ethereum Layer 2, powered by the Solana VM. Our general-purpose L2 combines the best of the modular stack without sacrificing UX or fragmenting liquidity. On top of this foundation, we’re building apps in-house and iterating quickly to find breakout consumer and AI experiences. We’re backed by top investors including Polychain, Tribe Capital, Placeholder, and DBA.

  • Opportunity. We believe blockchains should be fast AND highly usable. You’ll do high-impact work to enhance Ethereum’s scalability, shaping the future of crypto
  • Flexibility. We collaborate synchronously and asynchronously, across weekly all-hands meetings, Slack messaging, and quarterly in-person meetups
  • Team. Our founding team has experience launching and scaling blue-chip projects such as dYdX, Uniswap, and zkSync. We’re backed by leading funds and leaders including Polychain, Tribe, Placeholder, DBA, Mustafa Al-Bassam, Tarun Chitra, Meltem Demirors, and others
  • Culture. As an early member of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape our culture. We value intellectual honesty, bias towards action, and believe every member plays a key role in achieving our ambitious goals
  • Compensation. You’ll receive a competitive salary + equity + benefits package.

Mapeamento e diagnóstico:

  • Mapear e documentar os processos do cliente nos domínios atendidos pela Fin-X, delimitando fronteiras de processo e premissas

  • Levantar volumetria e evidência de gargalo com base em dado da operação, não em percepção

  • GCP Integration: Leverage Vertex AI for model serving and LLM models for reasoning, optimizing for long-context windows to process complex medical history.

  • Mentorship: Guide a team of engineers in MLOps best practices (CI/CD for models, evaluation pipelines).
  • Evaluation: Implement "LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks to automatically test agent accuracy against "Golden Datasets" of clinical cases.

Required Technical Skills

  • Core AI: Deep proficiency with LangChain or LangGraph, and specific experience with the Vertex AI SDK and ADK (Agent Development Kit) is highly desired
  • LLMs: Expertise in prompting and configuring LLMs, specifically utilizing Function Calling and Context Caching.

  • Data Engineering: Strong SQL skills for BigQuery; experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus, or Vertex Vector Search)

    • Familiarity with scalable, enterprise-level distributed systems

    • Demonstrated history of product value delivery
  • Education:

    • Must be a US Citizen, Green Card holder, or currently in the US having a valid H1B visa

Click on Park University Locations for more information on our campus centers.

The university will recruit and employ qualified personnel and will provide equal opportunities during employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or status as a qualified protected veteran. Please Note: Park University participates in E-Verify for all positions at all campus center locations nationwide.

Please note: California residents are eligible for on-ground courses only and are not eligible for online course assignments. Please check our website to view any currently posted on- ground opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications

The Computer Science department requires that you specifically address how professional experience, or graduate coursework pertains to Core Learning Outcome with your Questionnaire submission.

Core Learning Outcomes
1. Describe the role of the Cyber security Operations Analyst in the enterprise.
2. Analyze the operation of network infrastructures, protocols and services.
3. Demonstrate various types of network attacks.
4. Practice various methods to identify, monitor, prevent, respond and analyze attacks to computer networks, hosts, and data.

Applicants MUST hold the Instructor Training Certification (ITC) for CCNA Cybersecurity Operation. This requirement is non-negotiable. Candidates without this certification will not be considered.

Masters or Ph.D. level degree in CS or IS or in a related discipline (MBA, etc.) from an accredited school AND received graduate credit with a grade of B or better in the course applied to teach, OR one year work experience in subject material of course applied to teach.

Course Description

This course will focus on the principles, knowledge, skills, and tools about secure operations of computers, networks, and information technology systems. Topics include security concepts, cryptography, attack methods, security monitoring, incident response, handling and analysis. The course will contain various hands-on security labs. This course includes the concepts in a course recommended by Cisco for Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate (CBROPS) certification. Due to the particularly dynamic nature of the web environment, course content will change as appropriate.

jobs.title: Client Value Partner
jobs.excerpt: The Client Value Partner Role at ExelabExelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective.
jobs.description:
The Client Value Partner Role at Exelab

Exelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective. We run every engagement like a small product effort: we start from a real problem and craft a solution to move a real metric (revenue, efficiency, conversion, retention). We work in small, tight teams, close to the client's business, and we use AI directly in how we design and build. What matters to us is the impact we create for clients.

The Client Value Partner owns Exelab's relationship with a set of clients and the value we create for them. The Client Value Partner is the trusted presence at the table: someone who understands each client's business deeply, finds where Exelab can move a real metric, and turns that into a real solution, doing the analysis and the functional design and working with a Solution Architect on the technical depth. The role is about growing each client over time, turning a first engagement into a lasting relationship. It spans several clients and industries through the year, so it rewards someone who reads a business fast and carries real standing with senior decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

The Client Value Partner owns the relationship and the value for a portfolio of clients. The core responsibilities:

  • Own the client relationship: Be the person the client trusts. Stay close to their business, understand where they are heading, and be present at the moments that matter (including in person). The Client Value Partner is accountable for the health of the relationship and for putting Exelab's effort where it creates the most value.

  • Find where the value is: Run the discovery that surfaces the real problems and opportunities. Ask the questions that get to what genuinely moves the client's numbers, and turn that into a clear direction worth pursuing.

  • Analyze the need and design the solution: Turn the opportunity into a concrete solution: do the analysis and the functional design, leaving the fine technical detail to a Solution Architect who partners on depth and feasibility. Own the solution enough to make it real and to make the client believe in it.

  • Grow the account: Turn a first project into a lasting, growing relationship. Spot the next opportunity, make the case, and expand the value Exelab delivers.

  • Carry the standing: Hold ground with senior stakeholders: the calm, credible presence who can challenge a client's assumption, reframe a problem, and keep the trust.

In summary, the Client Value Partner is Exelab's owner of client and value: the person who understands a business, finds where we can help, shapes the solution, and grows the relationship over time. It is a role for someone with real standing, sharp judgment, and a genuine pleasure in working with people.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

Our ideal Client Value Partner is an experienced, credible operator who grows the clients they touch. There is no need to match every line below: the core is standing, a track record of growing clients, and the ability to turn an opportunity into a designed solution.

  • A track record of growing clients: Clients (and the companies they worked for) that grew because of them, with numbers to show it. They think in terms of the value created.

  • Standing and people-reading: Senior stakeholders take them seriously. Sharp, quick, empathetic; they enjoy being with people and build trust naturally.

  • Discovery and solution design: They ask the questions that surface the real problem, and they carry it through to a designed solution: analysis and functional design, with technical partners on the depth.

  • Business understanding, and enough technology: They grasp a client's business model fast, and they understand technology well enough to shape a solution with our architects.

  • Practical: Native or C2-level Italian, and based in Italy. Closing contracts sits with our commercial team; the Client Value Partner's focus is trust and value.
