jobs.title: Client Success Manager, Oracle EPM/ERP - MANAGED SERVICES - U.S. or Canada
jobs.excerpt: Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change.
jobs.description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

The Digital Managed Services Client Success Manager (CSM) owns the client relationship, value, and outcomes for a portfolio of approximately 10 Oracle managed services clients. The CSM is the accountable layer of the delivery model: driving governance, the service roadmap, and client satisfaction, and acting as the primary escalation point and strategic interface between the client and Huron's Service Delivery Managers (SDMs) and individual contributors across the EPM and ERP towers. This role is responsible for meeting client expectations, achieving service level agreements (SLAs), protecting engagement margin, and maximizing client satisfaction and renewal.

The Client Success Manager is central to the successful delivery of Oracle managed services. By owning the client relationship, enforcing governance and ticket discipline, applying hands-on EPM or ERP knowledge, and driving continuous improvement, the CSM protects service quality and margin while positioning Huron for renewal and growth. This role requires strong leadership, functional depth, commercial judgment, and a client-centric mindset.

Join One of Huron's Highest-Retention Teams
•Join one of Huron's highest-retention teams with a strong, collaborative culture.
•Work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. or Canada.
•Grow your career within a market-leading Oracle consulting practice.

Key Responsibilities:

•Client Relationship Management: Own the client relationship end to end, acting as trusted advisor and single point of accountability. Lead weekly operational status calls and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), understand client priorities, and align service delivery with their business objectives.
•Governance and Escalation: Establish and run the governance model (cadence, stakeholders, reporting) at client onboarding, and serve as the escalation point for client-facing issues, contractual risks, and prioritization decisions.
•Hands-On Oracle EPM or ERP Expertise: Apply direct, hands-on experience in Oracle EPM (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, EDM, Narrative Reporting) or Oracle Cloud ERP (GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Tax, Expense, HCM, SCM) to review solutions, challenge estimates, assess ticket quality, and act as an informed counterpart to delivery teams and clients.
•Service Delivery Oversight: Oversee end-to-end delivery of managed services for the assigned portfolio, ensuring adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and contractual obligations. Monitor response and resolution performance, ticket aging, backlog, and deferred items in ServiceNow, and drive corrective action where deviations occur.
•Ticket and Case Governance: Ensure incidents and service requests are accurately categorized, prioritized, documented, and updated; conduct regular ticket reviews with SDMs and individual contributors; and confirm that resolution notes and status reflect the true state of the work.
•Enhancement and Change Management: Manage demand intake for client requests, prioritize by business value, approve level-of-effort estimates, and ensure enhancements follow the agreed change request/approval process before work begins. Coordinate release, migration, and client sign-off activities.
•Advisory Services: Advise clients on new Oracle quarterly features, release impacts, and leading practices, translating product updates into client-specific recommendations and roadmap items.
•Commercial and Margin Management: Track hours consumption and burn rate against contracted volumes, provide clients with proactive updates to avoid surprises, identify write-off and scope risks, and support renewals, change orders, and expansion opportunities with the sales and account teams.
•Onboarding and Transition: Lead client onboarding and transition activities, including SOW reviews with the internal team, knowledge transfer planning, ServiceNow account and coordinator setup, environment and access coordination, and hypercare handover to steady-state support.
•Performance Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and present client-facing KPI and performance reporting, highlighting achievements, trends, and areas for improvement, and translate data into actionable service improvement plans.
•Vendor and Oracle Coordination: Manage interactions with Oracle Support and third-party vendors, including service request escalation strategy and joint review calls, ensuring alignment on client priorities.
•Service Improvement: Continuously assess and improve delivery processes, identifying opportunities for automation (including regression testing), standardization, and AI-enabled efficiency to improve quality, reduce cost, and increase satisfaction.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience implementing, administering, or supporting Oracle EPM (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, EDM) or Oracle Cloud ERP/Financials, with the ability to engage credibly on functional and technical topics.
  • Proven experience as a Client Success Manager, engagement/project manager, or service delivery lead in a managed services or IT services environment, managing a portfolio of concurrent clients.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional onshore and offshore delivery teams without direct reporting authority, including coverage planning and resource escalation.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent ITSM platform), SLA models, incident/service request management, and ITIL frameworks.
  • Strong commercial acumen: SOW interpretation, hours and margin tracking, change order and estimate review.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead executive-level status calls and QBRs and to handle difficult conversations constructively.
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • ITIL, PMP, or Oracle Cloud certifications are a plus; bilingual English/French capability is an asset for Canadian and Quebec-based clients.
  • Position is 100% remote

The estimated base salary for this job is $135,000 - $165,000 (U.S.). The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $162,000 - $198,000 (U.S.). The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental, and vision coverage and other wellness programs.

Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Director, Web Platform Engineering leads Greystar's web platform team and owns technical direction for greystar.com and the broader Sitecore-based web ecosystem, a multi-year platform commitment whose primary job is turning visitors into leases, and happy residents! You partner
with the product lead, who owns the roadmap and business direction, as a technical peer, a genuine technical counterpart to product on where the platform goes next.

This is a leader-doer role for a small but mighty strong team. You’ll bring deep, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI, while staying solutions-focused rather than platform-focused. Sitecore is the backbone of how we deliver, not the default answer to every problem. You’ll bring that same flexibility in how the platform approaches search and discovery, and build culture of shared documentation and knowledge so expertise lives with the team rather than any one person. You'll also invest directly in developing the engineers on your team and work across our global organization.

You'll set technical direction, stay hands-on, and hold yourself and the team to a standard of collaborative decision-making. As part of the Data, Digital, and AI (D2AI) organization, you'll coordinate with fellow D2AI teams (data platform, CI, AI engineering) on how the web platform connects to broader data and AI capabilities.

JOB DESCRIPTION

What You Will Do

Technical Direction & Product Partnership
• Own technical direction for the web platform, partnering with the product lead as a peer to shape priorities and sequencing together.
• Translate business priorities (leads and leases, campaign enablement, SEO,
personalization and experimentation) into technical strategy.
• Represent the web platform in enterprise technology planning, aligning direction with the rest of D2AI and broader Greystar priorities.

Lead From the Front
• Stay hands-on: contribute directly and daily to architecture, code review, and development across the platform.
• Set the technical example for the team, modeling the standard of work and collaborative decision-making you expect from them.

Web Platform Architecture & Engineering
• Bring deep, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI, Vercel, and any other evolving web-based technologies across Greystar’s digital properties, with greystar.com as the flagship.
• Own architectural decisions for personalization, experimentation, and content delivery on the platform.
• Guide the team's ongoing development, staying current on the platform's roadmap and capabilities as Greystar's committed CMS.
• Guide architecture and strategy for site search and discovery, ensuring relevance and performance keep pace with business goals.
• Partner with the marketing team on content management and operations needs as they evolve.
• Coordinate with D2AI's data platform and CI teams on how the web platform consumes and exchanges data (Cosmos DB, Salesforce, Databricks), partnering on integration points without owning that broader architecture.

AI-Forward Engineering Practices
• Use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) in your own day-today work, modeling high-leverage, AI-forward practices for the team.
• Champion automated testing practices, unit tests, visual regression tests, or similar, as AIaccelerated development increases the pace and volume of change.
• Evaluate and adopt AI-enabled tooling for content operations, personalization, and testing.
• Coach the team on effective, responsible use of AI in their own engineering workflows.

People Leadership, Mentorship & Career Management
• Lead, coach, and grow the existing team, providing hands-on technical guidance and architectural thinking.
• Own performance management, career development, and growth planning for each team member; mentorship and career growth are core expectations of this role.
• Hire selectively to complement the team's existing strengths as the roadmap requires.

Platform Documentation & Knowledge Distribution
• Document architecture, integrations, and operational knowledge so it lives with the team, not any single person.
• Cross-train the team and distribute access and ownership so no one, including you, becomes the only person who can operate a given part of the platform.

Production Support & Operations

• Own break-fix resolution and production support (L2/L3) for the web platform, in-house, ensuring issues are resolved within SLA.
• Maintain release processes, deployment standards, and on-call practices for the team.

How You Operate
• Strong opinions, weakly held: you can pivot fast when the situation calls for it, no sacred cows, no attachment to a decision just because you made it.
• You're comfortable moving forward when strategy is still taking shape, and you don't need every answer settled to make progress.
• You look for pragmatic, collaborative paths forward, the phased rollout or the wellscoped experiment, rather than forcing all-or-nothing choices.
• You document and share knowledge as second nature, and you take real satisfaction in building up the people around you.
• You see the product lead as a genuine partner in shaping the platform's direction.

What You Bring
Web Platform Engineering Excellence
• 10+ years of web platform or CMS engineering experience, with deep, current, hands-on expertise in Sitecore AI and headless implementations. This is not a role for someone who has moved fully away from the keyboard.
• Strong hands-on background in modern headless frontend architecture and Vercel or similar deployment platforms.
• Deep experience with search platforms (Coveo, Algolia, Elasticsearch, or similar) is a must. Coveo experience specifically is valued.
• Proficient with Git and modern CI/CD practices; experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

Leadership & Communication
• 5+ years leading engineering teams, with a genuine, demonstrable track record of mentoring engineers and helping them grow their careers.
• Experience partnering with a product lead or product manager who owns roadmap direction, in a peer relationship rather than a reporting one.
• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to represent the platform to senior technology and business leadership.

AI & Modern Tooling
• Deep, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot, not just awareness of them.
• Genuine enthusiasm for using AI to accelerate engineering work, with real examples of how you've applied it.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience partnering with marketing teams on content management platforms and operations.
• Experience on a conversion-focused digital platform (lead generation or e-commerce, not just content/brand).
• Experience operating a platform across multiple regions (this platform also supports Greystar's European operations).
• Datadog or equivalent monitoring/observability expertise.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent

experience.

Tools & Technologies
Sitecore AI, Next.js/React (App Router), Vercel, Coveo, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Git, LaunchDarkly, Datadog, Figma, Linear, AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot)

jobs.description:
Vannevar is a defense technology company building AI to deter our adversaries. In the 21st century, conflict moves at algorithmic speed and foresight equals firepower. Our agentic AI is purpose-built to compete with China—from cross-Strait conflict to gray zone coercion. Trained on the most mission-relevant datasets in defense, our technology models adversary behavior, simulates campaigns, and recommends the best course of action to decision makers. Our AI systems are some of the most trusted in the industry and actively used on the front lines of the Indo-Pacific to keep the peace and save lives.

Exceptional technology starts with exceptional people. Vannevar is a small agile team combining world-class engineers with veteran strategists who bring deep expertise in defense and tradecraft. We’re building a company defined by mission impact, user empathy, and disciplined growth. In just three years, we grew from $3M to $80M in ARR, achieved early profitability, and reached unicorn status—proving that disruption doesn’t require an ego, and staying power doesn’t mean standing still.

About the Role

Machine learning is core to Vannevar's enrichment capabilities, powering intelligent data extraction, classification, and augmentation at scale. Our ML team builds the services and infrastructure that enable products across Vannevar to leverage state-of-the-art models for mission-critical enrichment workflows. We own the end-to-end ML platform, from training and fine-tuning models to deploying high-performance inference services, and we operate these capabilities in demanding production environments.

You will be a technical leader driving the development of scalable ML services for enrichment. You'll work across the full ML lifecycle, from experimenting with and training models using frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face, to deploying optimized inference services using ONNX, vLLM, and other deployment libraries. You'll partner with product teams to understand enrichment requirements, architect robust ML pipelines that handle large-scale data processing, and ensure our services meet strict performance and reliability standards in production.

What you'll do

  • Design and build scalable ML services for enrichment workflows, including model training pipelines and high-performance inference APIs
  • Deploy and optimize models using modern inference libraries and frameworks (ONNX, vLLM, TensorRT, etc.) to achieve low-latency, high-throughput performance
  • Collaborate with software engineers and product teams to define data requirements, feature engineering strategies, and model evaluation metrics

Job Title

Kaplan International Pathways, a division of Kaplan Inc., offers international students a wide range of flexible study options - from university preparation programmes in the UK, Australia, USA and Japan through to full degree programmes in Singapore, Hong Kong and Australia. This role owns the full lifecycle of high school engagement — from initial outreach and relationship-building through to converting prospective students and their families into enrolled students at Kaplan's UK university partners. jobs.description:
Associate Director Product Development Program Manager, Digital Assessments

College Board – Office of the CEO (OCEO)

Location:

  • This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. Specific travel details can be found below.

Role Type:

  • This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Digital Product team drives College Board’s evolution toward a next-generation digital assessment experience. Digital Product team members partner across the organization to ensure every solution we build improves outcomes for students, educators, and institutions. Within this organization, the Digital Product Development Program Management (PDPM) team orchestrates the delivery of these high-impact initiatives.

We are a collaborative group of program and project managers who guide and support cross-functional workstreams spanning assessment operations, digital readiness, and assessment delivery. We ensure efficient coordination across business, product, and technology partners—balancing strategy with execution and ensuring workstreams move from concept to launch and operational execution seamlessly.

About the Opportunity

As Associate Director, Product Development Program Manager, Digital Assessments, you will play a key execution role in supporting the technical readiness and delivery of digital assessments. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented project professional eager to deepen their understanding of the digital assessment delivery and contribute to high-quality execution. Your primary focus will be on supporting pilots and research studies, including platform testing, technical validation, and readiness activities, with quality checks embedded throughout all assigned work.

Working under the direction of senior PDPM staff, you will execute defined components of digital assessment initiatives—maintaining disciplined documentation, issues or risk tracking, and validation processes to ensure stable outcomes. This role blends structured project coordination with hands-on technical execution and requires precision, follow-through, and a strong commitment to building quality into every deliverable. You will partner closely with PDPM, Product, Technology, and Assessment Delivery teams to support reliable and operationally ready digital assessments.

In this role, you will:

Pilot & Study Support (50%)

  • Provide structured technical and operational support for pilots and research studies, including environment validation, configuration checks, and follow-up documentation.

  • Confirm readiness of system components prior to pilot launch by executing predefined validation steps and reporting findings clearly.

  • Execute pilot and study readiness tasks—including material preparation, device validation, participant communications, and documentation management—to ensure operational preparedness and smooth administration.

  • Support pilots and studies during live administration (virtually or onsite), assisting with coordination, troubleshooting, and real-time issue management to ensure smooth execution.

  • Partner with PDPM, product, and technology teams to ensure pilot feedback is captured comprehensively and reflected in post-pilot documentation.

Technical Execution & Testing Support (30%)

  • Execute defined technical workstream tasks in support of Digital Assessment Platform initiatives under the direction of senior PDPM staff.

  • Carry out Smoke Testing activities for AP and CRA administrations, ensuring all test cases, configurations, and validation steps are executed thoroughly and documented accurately.

  • Follow established project plans and testing strategies, maintaining detailed tracking artifacts including test logs, validation documentation, and defect reports.

  • Escalate risks, inconsistencies, and defects promptly with clear documentation and recommended next steps.

  • Ensure assigned deliverables meet established quality standards prior to review or handoff.

Quality & Process Discipline (20%)

  • Apply a detail-oriented, quality-first approach to all assigned workstreams, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and traceability of documentation.

  • Utilize standardized checklists, validation protocols, and quality controls to reduce operational risk and prevent avoidable defects.

  • Contribute to retrospectives by identifying execution-level improvement opportunities and process gaps.

  • Continuously refine personal workflows to improve efficiency, clarity, and reliability of outputs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Scoped Contribution: When assigned, you independently manage defined components of a pilot or study—tracking progress, coordinating validation and/or readiness steps, and delivering within established parameters under senior guidance.

  • Built-In Quality: You apply structured quality checks to your work, ensuring deliverables are complete, validated, and ready before handoff. Issues, risks, or blockers are clearly documented, and followed up on until they are resolved, minimizing rework and operational risk.

  • Disciplined Execution: You reliably execute assigned work with strong attention to detail, completing validation activities thoroughly, maintainingaccurate documentation, and escalating risks early to prevent avoidable issues.

  • Reliable Partner: Senior PDPM staff and cross-functional teams experience you as organized and dependable. You provide clear updates, follow established plans, and consistently follow through on commitments.

About You

You bring strong execution discipline, attention to detail, and foundational project management skills to support digital assessment initiatives under senior guidance. You are organized, quality-focused, and dependable—committed to building structured validation and accuracy into every deliverable.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in project coordination, technical operations, digital product support, QA/testing support, or assessment delivery.

  • Experience executing defined project plans with attention to detail, including maintaining documentation, tracking tasks, and supporting validation or testing activities.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify issues, document defects or risks clearly, and escalate appropriately.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing status updates, meeting notes, and structured documentation.

  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite; familiarity with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar tracking and project management tools.

  • The ability to travel up to 12 times per year (about once per month) to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

Preferred Qualifications

  • Location in the Northeastern or Mid-Atlantic United States, as travel will largely focus in these areas

  • Experience supporting digital assessment, education technology, platform testing, or technical validation activities.

  • Familiarity with structured testing processes, defect tracking workflows, or quality assurance practices.

  • Experience working in cross-functional environments with product and technology teams.

  • Exposure to Agile or iterative delivery environments.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assigned tasks while maintaining quality and accuracy.

  • This role requires the ability to lift up to 25 lbs, stand for extended periods (up to 4 hours at a time), and occasionally bend, reach, or kneel to complete job duties.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While thehiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $68,000 - $105,000

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out ourcareers page for more.

About Foundever:

Foundever™ is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 170,000 associates across the globe, we are the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support the operational needs of our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.


Job Summary

We are looking for a commercially driven Director of AI Professional Services to lead our growing AI delivery practice. From prototyping to production, you will first need to assess and define the best way to address the client’s need to secure revenue, weather through the EverSuite capability, a custom solution (AI or not). If a custom AI solution is needed, you will lead its development. If the solution is effectively sold, you will oversee the transition to operationalization. At first, you will personally work with sales and one developer to discover, prototype, demo and deliver the solution. As demand grows, you will have to build the team, the delivery methodology and a sustainable operation model. This is a rare opportunity to build something from the ground up — with full commercial ownership, direct client impact, and the backing of a global AI-powered organization.

Key responsibilities

Client Delivery & Engagement

  • Take a client brief from whiteboard to working demo within days, not weeks: personally prototype solutions in the first client engagements, before the team is built
  • Design and deliver tailored AI solutions leveraging LLMs, agents, and AI-assisted development workflows, from discovery through go-live, favoring quick ROI but aligning with EverSuite roadmap
  • Create repeatable offerings such as AI discovery workshop, rapid prototyping, paid pilots implementation packages and managed AI solution support.
  • Oversee the transition of delivered solutions to production — covering monitoring, reliability, cost control, support models, and migration to standard offerings where appropriate
  • Establish standards for responsible AI delivery, including data privacy, security, model selection, prompt/version management, monitoring and safeguards where required.

Commercial Ownership

  • Own the P&L for the professional services practice, including revenue targets and margin
  • Partner with Sales to scope, price, and close new services opportunities
  • Develop repeatable service packages, pricing models, and statements of work
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts to grow ARR and services revenue

Practice Building

  • Build, hire, and mentor a team of AI consultants, engineers, and solution architects, from scratch.
  • Establish delivery methodologies, quality standards, and playbooks for AI implementations
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to feed client insights back into the roadmap

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years in professional services, consulting, or solutions delivery — ideally in an AI, data, or SaaS context
  • Proven commercial track record: owned revenue targets, managed SOWs, and driven services P&L
  • Strong hands-on fluency with AI assisted development workflow (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, v0, Replit, etc.) to prototype, scaffold, and ship working software rapidly, while maintaining engineering judgment around security, scalability, maintainablity and production readiness.
  • Fluency in LLM application patterns: RAG, agents, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and tool use
  • Ability to operate at the whiteboard with engineers and in the boardroom with C-suite stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale delivery teams in a fast-moving environment

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in enterprise software, cloud platforms, or AI/ML infrastructure
  • Experience selling or delivering services in regulated industries
  • Startup or scale-up experience — comfortable with ambiguity and building from scratch
  • Familiarity with MLOps, vector databases, or AI safety considerations

WHAT 'VIBE CODING FLUENCY' MEANS HERE

This isn't a checkbox. We expect our Director to personally use AI-assisted development tools — not just understand them conceptually. You should be able to spin up a working prototype with an LLM in hours, review AI-generated code critically, and coach clients on integrating vibe coding into their own development culture.

You don't need to be a career software engineer. But you should be someone who has shipped things with these tools and has a point of view on where they accelerate delivery and where they introduce risk.

About the role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically strong Senior Revenue Accountant to join our growing finance team. In this role you will own end-to-end revenue accounting and reporting across our portfolio of licensed software, SaaS subscriptions, website development projects, implementation engagements, and ongoing support services. You will be a key voice in applying and evolving our ASC 606 policies, partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and FP&A, and serving as a subject-matter expert for internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain revenue recognition policies and procedures in accordance with ASC 606 across all revenue streams — licensed software, SaaS, website-based products, implementation, and support services.

  • Prepare and review monthly revenue journal entries, deferred revenue roll-forwards, and related account reconciliations.

  • Ensure accurate and timely recording of variable consideration, contract modifications, and multi-element arrangements.

  • Manage accounting for costs related to revenue-generating activities including costs to obtain and fulfill customer contracts (ASC 340-40), software publisher/royalty costs, and related capitalization and amortization schedules.

  • Monitor and reconcile deferred commission and contract cost balances; assess for impairment as needed.

  • Serve as an active contributor to the monthly and quarterly close process, including preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance explanations.

  • Prepare and maintain bad debt reserve calculations; analyze aged accounts receivable and communicate trends to management.

  • Reconcile intercompany accounts, including transfer pricing, and investigate and resolve variances on a timely basis.

  • Support additional general ledger responsibilities and ad hoc accounting projects as assigned.

  • Support sales and use tax research, nexus analysis, and related accounting entries in partnership with Tax and outside advisors.

  • Partner with external auditors; prepare PBC schedules and respond to audit requests efficiently and accurately.

  • Collaborate with the billing, collections, sales operations and customer success teams to resolve customer accounting questions and billing disputes.

  • Work closely with FP&A and business leaders to provide revenue and gross margin reporting and analysis that supports decision-making.

  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, and internal controls.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to revenue recognition in a technology or software company.

  • Deep working knowledge of ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent considerations.

  • Hands-on experience with revenue accounting across SaaS, subscription and perpetual licensing, professional services, and web-based product lines.

  • Solid understanding of ASC 340-40 contract cost accounting (costs to obtain and fulfill).

  • Experience with bad debt reserve methodologies (aging analysis, historical loss rates, specific identification).

  • Demonstrated ability to prepare and review PBC schedules and support external audit processes.

  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, complex formulas); proficiency in a major ERP system (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar).

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written/verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical accounting concepts to non-accounting stakeholders.

  • CPA preferred

Who you are

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized with a proactive, problem-solving mindset. They communicate effectively across teams, work well independently, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. A strong sense of accountability, professionalism, and collaboration is essential for success in this role.

Other information

Type of role: Permanent

Location: North America, Remote

Start date: Asap

At Truvio you will be part of a fast-growing modern SaaS environment that brings together established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs in one unified company, delivering a single, intelligent product portfolio built exclusively for Dynamics 365. This way we help customers and partners close the ERP Value Gap by unifying finance, operations, and commerce within a Microsoft-native suite.

We are a team of more than 450 employees worldwide, with colleagues based across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. With our core values, Take Ownership, Build Trust, Drive Innovation and Succeed Together, we have a mission to help organizations get more from their ERP investments.

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

If you want a role where your decisions show up directly in a P&L, where you have real access to the executive team, and where the org chart hasn't fully hardened yet, this is that role. TopDog Law is the fastest-growing personal injury firm in the country, and we’re making investments to continue that growth.

We're hiring a VP of Regional Operations to be the operational owner and right hand to leadership across an assigned multi-state region. You'll sit at the center of intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements for your states, connecting state managing attorneys with the centralized platform teams who can partner with them to solve the problems.

You will own making sure the right issues get identified, prioritized by ROI, escalated to the right people, and resolved with feedback back to the states. Your region's profitability is the clearest measure of your impact, and you'll partner closely with the COO and your region's managing attorneys to get there.

What You Will Own

Regional Operational Leadership

  • Serve as the operational lead and primary point of connection across every function touching your region's states, including intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements.
  • Act as the “air traffic controller” for your region. Know what's happening in every state, spot where teams are duplicating effort or dropping the ball, and get the right people working the right problems.
  • Partner with state managing attorneys as operational co-pilots. You are jointly accountable for state performance and for ensuring all teams execute at their highest level.
  • Support new-state launches in your region, including helping stand up managing attorneys, getting case intake and workflows running, and building out the state's operating rhythm.

Prioritization, Escalation and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Continuously surface operational issues across your states, including provider and client care gaps, tech and product friction, staffing and capacity constraints, and process breakdowns.
  • Translate the long list of things that could be fixed into the handful of highest-ROI priorities for each state, rather than trying to solve everything at once.
  • Route issues to the right centralized or platform team (client care, tech, analytics, marketing, recruiting, training, compliance, intake) and drive them to resolution.
  • Close the loop by making sure state managing attorneys get clear, timely feedback on the status of issues you've escalated on their behalf.
  • Maintain a transparent, recurring view of your region's active priorities and projects so managing attorneys and leadership always know what's being worked and why.

Performance, Accountability and Decision Rights

  • Treat regional P&L as your central KPI. You are expected to know your states' numbers as well as, or better than, anyone else in the business.
  • Build and maintain expected capacity models by role and by state (case managers, legal assistants, litigation staff, and so on), recognizing that the right staffing level differs state to state.
  • Work with managing attorneys and analytics to define KPIs, goals, and scorecards by state that roll up to the regional P&L.
  • Help define where managing attorneys have full decision-making authority versus where changes require a recommendation and sign-off from you or the COO, for example case phase movement criteria, staffing levels, or case cost thresholds. Protect national consistency where it matters while preserving state-level autonomy where it doesn't.

Team Development and Operating Cadence

  • Directly manage and develop an operations manager or right hand, delegating project-based work to them while keeping them fully looped in on regional priorities and decisions.
  • Run or actively participate in your region's operating cadence, including weekly leadership syncs, state-level team meetings, and a monthly regional operating review with managing attorneys, analytics, the COO, and the CEO.
  • Coach state managing attorneys and their teams on prioritization, giving them the information they need to run their state and recognizing where you're seeing deficiencies before they become bigger problems.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of operations leadership experience, ideally spanning multiple sites, states, or business units in a fast-growing or professional services environment
  • Strong financial and P&L fluency. Comfortable using a profit-and-loss statement to prioritize, not just review, operational work (accounting, finance, or analytical background strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize a large volume of competing issues by ROI and impact, and communicate that prioritization clearly to stakeholders at every level
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence and drive execution through people you don't directly manage
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity within a fast-scaling, still-being-defined organizational structure
  • Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, the full personal injury case lifecycle: intake and case value, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements
  • Experience developing and delegating to direct reports, with the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to hand something off, and to whom
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to states within your assigned region
  • High intellectual curiosity, strong organizational skills, and genuine enjoyment of connecting people and solving cross-functional problems

Preferred:

  • Experience leading operations for a multi-state or multi-office personal injury law firm, with direct exposure to intake, pre-litigation, litigation, and settlements
  • A track record of partnering with attorneys or partners on business and operational performance, not just running internal operations in isolation
  • Familiarity with legal case management systems and how case-level data translates into staffing, KPI, and financial decisions
  • Experience standing up or scaling a regional operating model inside a high-growth company

Growth and Impact

This role sits inside a company significantly growing and optimizing its operating model, not maintaining one that's already set. You'll have direct visibility with senior leadership, real influence over how our national operating standards evolve, and the chance to build a track record running a multi-million-dollar P&L rather than just contributing to one.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking “what's next?”
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $180,000 to $210,000, commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for a performance-based bonus tied to regional profitability
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Customer Success Professional – Indirect is a customer and partner facing role assigned to our large and mid-market enterprise customer segment and aligned to our largest revenue sub-agents. Driving overall customer lifetime value with and through our partners. This role is accountable for the overall selling partner experience; creating an environment where it is easy to do business through Lumen, providing data-led insights to guide our partners actions and enabling adoption and utilization of digital tools.

Location

Due to the regional scope of this position, candidates must reside in Colorado or Texas to effectively support market activities, partner engagement, and customer-facing initiatives.

The Main Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain long-term, value-driven relationships with customers and partners to build trust and credibility
• Implement and manage customer and partner success plans aligned with business goals, ensuring value realization
• Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, delivery, and ecosystem partners to align on customer outcomes and solution expectations
• Orchestrate customer onboarding and lifecycle milestones using standardized journey templates for readiness and alignment
• Monitor and analyze customer and partner metrics (usage data, health indicators, financial metrics) to prioritize engagement and drive success
• Execute customer engagement strategies, including cadence calls, site visits, reviews, training, and digital touchpoints
• Drive product adoption and value realization by leveraging tools, accelerators, and feature communication
• Identify and qualify expansion opportunities within the portfolio, partnering with sales to support revenue growth
• Conduct regular business reviews with partners, assessing health, financial performance, and growth strategies
• Manage revenue retention, renewals, risk mitigation, and financial accountability across operations
• Communicate and escalate urgent customer concerns, coordinating mitigation plans and service improvement initiatives
• Facilitate internal knowledge sharing and action planning to continuously enhance customer and partner value

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 4+ years customer success or account management experience
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in working with complex, multi-regional enterprise customers
  • Ability to effectively present, consult, and advise at various leadership levels
  • Assertive verbal and written communications skills with ability to build strategic relationships within organizations
  • Ability to work closely with the customer and effectively negotiate directly with the customer and internally on their behalf
  • Ability to interpret customer data points and insight while implementing customer engagement action plans
  • Manage high volume of tasks with strong time management skills
  • Experience in collaborating and guiding cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Marketing, Service Delivery)

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges:

$57,309 - $76,409 in these states: CO

$60,039 - $80,042 in these states: TX

Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

Learn more about Lumen's:

  • Benefits
  • Bonus Structure

Requisition #: 342938

Life at Lumen

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:

Background Screening

If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page. Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all persons regardless of race, color, ancestry, citizenship, national origin, religion, veteran status, disability, genetic characteristic or information, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, family status, pregnancy, or other legally protected status (collectively, “protected statuses”). We do not tolerate unlawful discrimination in any employment decisions, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, benefits, discipline, termination, job assignments or training.

Privacy Notice

Lumen is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal information collected during the recruitment and hiring process. Our Applicant Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect applicant information, as well as how individuals may request access to or deletion of their personal data.

To review Lumen’s Global Employment Applicant and Talent Community Privacy Notice, please visit:

jobs.title: Tutor/a Online de Francés
jobs.excerpt: ¿Dominas el francés?  Convierte tus conocimientos en ingresos y enseña a tu ritmo.
jobs.description:
¿Dominas el francés? Convierte tus conocimientos en ingresos y enseña a tu ritmo.

En Tusclasesparticulares buscamos profesores/as, docentes, estudiantes y personas con buen nivel de francés para dar clases particulares online a alumnos de diferentes niveles.

No necesitas experiencia previa como profesor/a. Solo necesitas un buen dominio del francés y ganas de ayudar a tus alumnos a mejorar.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • 15–30 €/hora

  • Horario 100% flexible: tú decides cuándo dar clases.

  • 100% online: enseña desde donde quieras.

  • Tú eliges tu disponibilidad y puedes adaptar las clases a tu ritmo.

  • No necesitas experiencia previa como profesor/a.

  • Crea tu perfil gratis y empieza a recibir oportunidades de alumnos.

¿Qué harás?

  • Preparar clases personalizadas según el nivel y los objetivos de cada estudiante.

  • Practicar conversación, gramática, vocabulario y comprensión según las necesidades del alumno.

  • Explicar el idioma de forma clara y adaptada a cada nivel.

  • Acompañar al estudiante durante su aprendizaje y evolución.

  • Ayudar a los alumnos a mejorar su nivel de francés y alcanzar sus objetivos.

¿Qué necesitas?

  • Buen nivel de francés, desde nivel básico hasta avanzado.

  • No se requiere experiencia previa como profesor/a.

  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y ganas de enseñar.

  • Compromiso con los alumnos y capacidad para adaptar las clases a sus necesidades.

¿Quién puede apuntarse?

Buscamos perfiles con conocimientos de francés, incluyendo profesores/as, docentes, estudiantes universitarios, hablantes bilingües y personas con un buen dominio del idioma.

Tú decides cuándo enseñar y desde dónde hacerlo.

jobs.excerpt: LEUKAEMIA CARE TRUSTEE - REMOTEUNPAID - VOLUNTEER- ClinicalAs part of the Board, you will be responsible for the organisation’s governance, strategic direction and sustainability alongside a highly committed and welcoming team.
jobs.description:
LEUKAEMIA CARE TRUSTEE - REMOTE

UNPAID - VOLUNTEER

- Clinical

As part of the Board, you will be responsible for the organisation’s governance, strategic direction and sustainability alongside a highly committed and welcoming team. Your commitment will extend to:

  • Board of Trustees meetings (four per year*).
  • In-person attendance at the charity’s AGM (full day).
  • Contribute to the work of Sub-committee (around three per year).
  • Ad hoc availability as matters arise (by telephone/teleconference).
  • Attendance at key Leukaemia Care events.
  • Commit to the Board of Trustees for at least four years.

*Board meetings take place in hybrid form. Trustees can claim reasonable expenses, including help with travel and childcare.

Leukaemia Care is the UK’s leading leukaemia charity. For over 50 years, we have been dedicated to ensuring that everyone affected by leukaemia and associated conditions receives the best possible diagnosis, information, advice, treatment, and support.

In 2024, our support services were accessed more than 60,000 times.

  • Over £100,000 was paid out to those in need via our Cost of Living fund.
  • Over 600 people were supported by Leukaemia Care navigators in hospitals across the country.
  • Our Advice Service was accessed over 2,000 times.

“You fear the worst when you’re diagnosed with cancer, but Leukaemia Care provides compassion, help and support for those in need.”

Leukaemia Care’s Board of Trustees works to ensure that the charity is able to fully deliver on its purpose and mission. The Trustees are responsible for the effective and legal governance of the organisation, making sure that the charity is carrying out the purposes for which it was established, and is working for the public benefit and in line with the charity’s own governing documents.

The Board is currently looking for potential Trustees from across the UK who are able to bring knowledge and experience in the fields ofxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Qualities, skills and abilities for this role:

  • Good people and collaborative skills.
  • Able to commit enough time to the role.
  • Diplomacy and sensitivity.
  • Confidentiality.
  • Good independent judgment.
  • Ability to work effectively as a member of a team.
  • Integrity, openness, honesty.

There are a number of rules stipulated by the Charity Commission regarding the qualification of a person to act as a Trustee. Leukaemia Care will always undertake due diligence checks, (such as DBS) to ensure that all members of the Board meet these standards.

You don’t need to have been a Trustee before. What matters is your commitment to our values and your ability to think strategically, challenge constructively, and act in the best interests of the charity.

jobs.excerpt: We are driven to do more.  More for our customers and the financial professionals who offer our products.
jobs.description:
We are driven to do more. More for our customers and the financial professionals who offer our products. If you are driven to do more and love the challenge of pursuing more, Athene is your kind of company. You will find we offer more than the basics to create an inclusive and dynamic work environment at our various locations.

Purpose:

Athene is seeking a Vice President, Relationship Manager to drive growth within our Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) distribution channel by developing strategic relationships, expanding advisor engagement, and delivering industry-leading retirement income solutions. This role partners closely with Division Sales leadership to execute territory strategies that accelerate sales growth while strengthening Athene's market presence.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute a strategic territory business plan that drives sales growth, expands advisor relationships, and achieves business objectives across the IMO channel.

  • Build, maintain, and deepen relationships with Independent Marketing Organizations, financial advisors, and key distribution partners while identifying new business opportunities.

  • Deliver impactful product education, sales training, seminars, and consultative solutions that position Athene's Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) and Registered Indexed Linked Annuity (RILA) products for success.

  • Partner closely with Internal Wholesalers and cross-functional teams to execute territory strategies, optimize resource deployment, and provide exceptional advisor support.

  • Manage territory performance, business development initiatives, travel, and expense budgets while maintaining compliance with FINRA, SEC, Department of Insurance, and Athene policies.

  • Leverage market insights, data, digital tools, and AI-enabled resources to identify opportunities, strengthen advisor engagement, improve sales effectiveness, and continuously enhance the customer experience.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience wholesaling Fixed Indexed Annuities and/or Registered Indexed Linked Annuities within the Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) or Independent Broker Dealer (IBD) distribution channels, or relevant experience.

  • Proven track record of growing a sales territory, developing strategic advisor relationships, achieving sales goals, and influencing business outcomes through consultative selling and business development.

  • Strong knowledge of the annuity marketplace, territory management, advisor practices, and the financial services industry with demonstrated presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to think strategically, adapt quickly in a dynamic environment, leverage AI and technology appropriately to improve productivity, and demonstrate innovation, critical thinking, and a bias for action.

  • Active FINRA Series 6 and Life & Health licenses required. FINRA Series 7 and Series 63 licenses preferred. RICP designation required within 12 months of employment.

jobs.description:
Veritas Press is a Christian organization dedicated to providing the best classical Christian education materials and services anywhere. Veritas Scholars Academy (Veritas Press' Online Academy) consistently accepts resumés from exceptional teaching talent in all disciplines. If you are a highly skilled and caring teacher, please apply now. Our teachers enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere high speed internet is available.

Description:

Teacher is an independent contractor responsible for instructing courses as offered by VSA at mutually determined times, as defined in the teacher contract. Teachers are the most important component in a learning environment; therefore, VSA hires only the most qualified professionals to teach in our setting.

Some Responsibilities:

  1. Teach within the bounds of the Veritas Statement of Faith.
  2. Operate within all parameters of the VSA Teacher Handbook.
  3. Teach classes at regularly scheduled times.
  4. Grade and return all assignments within 48 hours. Exception: Papers greater than two pages are to be returned no later than 10 days past the submission due date.
  5. Attend monthly teacher meetings.
  6. Demonstrate proficiency in the use of learning technologies (Learning Management System (LMS), online classroom).
  7. Communicate routinely with students’ families (primarily messaging in LMS), specifically regarding student performance and progress.
  8. Respond to families’ communications the same day when possible, and no later than two business days.
  9. Communicate with students a minimum of one week before classes begin to ensure course expectations are clearly conveyed.
  10. Communicate with students as needed outside of scheduled class hours to support and answer questions.
  11. Complete quarterly comments to keep students and families well informed of students’ progress.
  12. Ensure final grades are assigned and available for viewing by the close of the school year.
  13. Assist administration in making placement determinations based upon students’ competency levels.
  14. Maintain close contact with parents when students show signs of struggling in a course. Be prepared to offer well-considered, insightful solutions for struggling learners.

Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Conversant with and supportive of the reformed faith and classical Christian education according to the VSA Statement of Faith and Philosophy
  2. Understanding one’s discipline with a strong biblical worldview
  3. Ever-increasing familiarity with and appreciation for VSA curriculum
  4. Skilled in effective communication via messaging and phone
  5. Energized by interactions with students and families
  6. Loves children, particularly the ages being taught
  7. Has a servant’s heart and is relationship-minded
  8. Works diligently day to day under direct and indirect supervision
  9. Operates with a high level of professionalism, continually pursuing excellence

Physical Demands:

  1. Standing, walking and sitting for long periods of time
  2. Extensive typing on QWERTY style keyboard
  3. Extensive viewing of lighted computer monitor
  4. Speaking and hearing
  5. Reaching and bending
  6. Lifting up to 25 lbs
  7. Using hands to perform tasks
  8. Working in standard office conditions with and near electronics

Education:

  1. A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  2. An advanced degree is desirable.

Instructions:

  • Be sure to answer all questions marked with an * on the application; they are required
  • If you're not sure of any of the other answers, leave them blank
  • Please upload a resume; we prefer PDF format
  • In the Cover Letter section, please write us a brief note to tell us why you're applying; it can be as formal as you want it to be; we just want to get to know you

jobs.description:

We’re looking for people who:

  • Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride

Job Description:

As a Renewal Account Executive within the Digital Shipping Solutions team, you will play a critical role in driving client retention and contributing directly to Pitney Bowes’ Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) goals. This job has 1 slot.

The non-negotiable compensation for this role is $21.88 per hour. This position is also eligible for incentive-based earnings, bringing the total on‑target earnings (OTE) to approximately $75,000 annually.

This is a remote Inside Sales position open to qualified candidates living in the United States. Candidates located in the PST and MST areas are not eligible for consideration for this job. You must reside in the EST and CST areas to be eligible for consideration for this job. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available now or in the future.

A successful Renewal Account Executive will bring a client‑centric mindset, a strong focus on closing business, and the ability to champion innovative ideas and strategies. You will serve as a subject matter expert on Pitney Bowes SendTech Shipping and Mailing Solutions.

Who You Are

  • A product‑oriented sales professional committed to delivering exceptional client satisfaction.
  • Skilled at identifying upsell and cross‑sell opportunities within the Pitney Bowes suite of solutions.
  • Motivated to continually grow and develop as an Account Executive in the technology space.
  • Experienced in Inside Sales, particularly within the Shipping or Mailing domains.

You are primarily responsible for leading, and advising Gartner clients by researching Emerging Technology and Trends (ETT) within cybersecurity markets; specifically the AI data security and AI ecosystem data management market. You will be charged with creating and delivering both strategic and tactical advice and research content which guides Technology CEOs, Product and Innovation Leaders, Product Managers, and Marketing professionals on critical future security technologies and trends through written research reports, presentations, teleconference inquiries, and briefings. Using Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools of the trade you will turn complex, cross-functional data and workflows into clear analysis and presentation decks that senior leadership and department heads can act on, and will help with coordination and implementation across departments for such programs.

The ideal candidate is as comfortable, for example, building a compensation model from scratch as they are distilling it into a clear, well-organized narrative for a monthly business review.

Meet the Team

Cisco and Splunk are building a safer, more resilient digital world. The Customer Problem Management team acts as a central hub that bridges technical and business stakeholders to drive accurate root cause analysis and ensure accountability for corrective actions. By partnering across departments, the team connects operational insights to product improvements and translates complex technical data into clear, impactful communications for customers and leadership.

Your Impact

As a Senior Problem Manager, you will transform customer-impacting incidents into actionable improvements and clear communications, ensuring systemic risks are mitigated before they recur. You will govern the post-incident lifecycle by partnering with global stakeholders to drive accountability and high-quality outcomes across the organization. Additionally, you will play a pivotal role in maturing our Problem Management practice by identifying emerging patterns through proactive data analysis to prevent future service failures. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations.
jobs.description:
Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations. In the 21st century we live in a business culture that demands cost and logistical efficiencies combined with increased productivity. Lanter's strategic, process driven approach has been embraced by the marketplace and is setting new standards in the automotive and agricultural manufacturing marketplace. We see a bright future on the road before us and we are very excited about bringing our solutions to a variety of new industries.

The ideal candidate will embody our company's Non-Negotiables:

  • Walk in Humble Confidence- We are experts at what we do, but we never assume we know everything
  • Be Open, Honest and Respectful- We say what has to be said in a tactful, courteous way
  • Be Fearless- We never fail, we only learn
  • We are One Team- We achieve more together by collaboration and consensus
  • Delivery on Commitments- We do what we say we will do
  • We have a Passion to Serve- We are dedicated, hardworking individuals who provide exceptional service to our customers and to each other
  • We put Safety First- We prioritize the safety of our team members and customers above all else in our business
  • We Strive for Operational Excellence- We are dedicated to a culture of continuous improvements, driving quality and productivity

Position Summary:

As a Senior BI Engineer, you'll play a key role in strengthening Lanter's enterprise data capabilities by designing scalable data models that turn diverse source-system data into reliable, reusable information for analytics and reporting. A key focus of this role is solving complex data modeling challenges. This includes bringing together data from across customers, business units, industries, and operational systems to create models that account for varying business rules, exceptions, and data requirements. Your work will help support increasingly sophisticated use cases, including real-time visibility into routes, shipments, stops, and the freight or items associated with them.

Working within Lanter's Azure data environment, you'll also develop and support ETL/ELT pipelines, write advanced SQL queries, and enable reporting through BI tools. As a senior technical contributor, you'll be a go-to resource for complex BI and data modeling work, helping ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Essential Duties and Key Deliverables:

  • Design scalable enterprise data models that integrate complex data from multiple operational systems into consistent, reusable structures for analytics and reporting.
  • Translate business needs into data models and reporting-ready datasets that account for varying business rules, data quality, source-system complexities, and use cases such as real-time operational visibility.
  • Build, enhance, and support ETL/ELT processes within the Azure data environment.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, datasets, and BI reporting solutions that enable accurate, timely business analysis.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate analytics and reporting needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Support data warehouse and BI initiatives tied to pharmaceutical requirements, the Descartes implementation, AI-related data needs, and other strategic priorities.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.
  • Deep hands-on data modeling experience, including designing integrated enterprise and/or dimensional models, establishing entities and relationships, determining grain and business rules, and reconciling differing source-system requirements.
  • Advanced SQL and strong ETL/ELT experience working with data from multiple operational systems.
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud-based data platforms and data lakes; experience with Databricks on Azure and Azure Data Lake is strongly preferred, with comparable cloud data platform experience considered transferable.
  • Experience translating complex or ambiguous business and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
  • Experience developing or supporting BI and reporting solutions using Sigma, Power BI, or a comparable platform.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to independently own complex work.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or other environments with complex operational data.
  • Experience with Descartes or similar transportation/logistics technology platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI or advanced analytics data initiatives.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities; however, the Senior BI Engineer is expected to provide technical guidance, review work, and serve as a go-to resource for complex BI engineering and data modeling needs.

Position Type:

This is a full-time, remote position, with a preference for candidates who can work from our St. Louis, Missouri headquarters.

Travel:

Travel may be required periodically for company meetings, training, or other business needs.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in a professional remote or office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other job-related technology or systems. The team member may be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer and communicating with internal and external business partners.

Physical Demands:

The team member is regularly required to listen, communicate verbally and in writing, sit for extended periods of time, use a computer and other office equipment, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds at a time.

Other Duties:

This job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may vary by location based on business needs and may change at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement:

Lanter Delivery Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Lanter Delivery Systems complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Lanter Delivery Systems expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Lanter Delivery Systems team members to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About The Role

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own product positioning and, in collaboration with other Bullhorn teams, develop go-to-market plans that drive growth and client retention. You will be looked at as a SME, leveraging this expertise in combination with strong business acumen to inform product and business strategy and enable key stakeholders.

A Typical Day Will Include...
